verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents a Handlebars-based Stencil theme engine with local development against live data (confirmed by a hands-on HN comment), but another hands-on developer describes the templating system as having 'hundreds of theme files' and a 'maddeningly incomplete and inconsistent templating tag system,' directly contradicting ease-of-use claims. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a version-controlled theme deploy workflow/CLI (e.g., Stencil CLI push/pull with git), and independent corroboration resolving the local-preview vs. templating-quality conflict.
